requirement.description: The DSL module has issues with handling If/Elif/Else constructs properly, causing AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items' when processing complex conditional statements.
requirement.contract: Fix the If/Elif/Else context managers in the Module class to correctly process nested conditional statements without throwing AttributeError. The implementation should properly handle statement resolution and ensure all conditional constructs are properly converted to the expected IR representation.

requirement.description: Switch construct implementation has issues with handling various switch cases, causing AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items' in multiple test cases.
requirement.contract: Ensure the Switch/Case context managers properly handle all types of switch cases (enum, string, integer) and correctly convert them to the expected IR representation. The implementation should correctly manage case patterns and statement resolution.

requirement.description: Missing or incorrect implementation of ValueCastable formatting which causes TypeError and assertion errors in various test cases.
requirement.contract: Implement proper ValueCastable formatting support that correctly handles Format operations and prevents TypeError when formatting ValueCastable objects. Ensure the error messages match the expected patterns in test assertions.

requirement.description: Memory constructor and related validation has incorrect error message formatting, causing assertion failures in multiple test cases.
requirement.contract: Update error messages in Memory constructor and related methods to match the exact expected format in test assertions. Ensure proper validation and consistent error messaging for memory-related operations.

requirement.description: Incorrect error message formatting for Case patterns and pattern validation, causing assertion failures in test cases.
requirement.contract: Correct the error message formatting for invalid Case patterns to match the expected patterns exactly. Ensure proper validation of pattern strings and error reporting for invalid bit patterns.
